chat.emptyHint: Ask a question, paste a problem, or attach a document — answers come with citations from your knowledge base.
chat.placeholder: Ask anything… Enter to send, Shift+Enter for newline
chat.knowledgeHint: Questions in this session search the selected knowledge bases; none selected means no retrieval
chat.modelHint: This session keeps using the selected model; the default follows Settings
chat.modelMissingKey: No API key configured (add one in Settings → Model)
chat.capabilityHint: Later turns in this session use the selected capability; chat by default
chat.capabilityBusy: Cannot switch capability while a turn is running
chat.capabilityChatHint: Ask and answer, with knowledge bases and tools
chat.capabilitySolveHint: Planning → reasoning → writing, a three-stage solution pipeline
chat.capabilityQuestionHint: Ideation → generation, then answer them in the question bank

models.providerDesc: Empty = follow NNNU_MODEL env / built-in default (DeepSeek)
models.baseUrlDesc: Empty = provider default endpoint; required for custom
models.modelDesc: Empty = provider's default model; free text supported
models.apiKeyDesc: Stored in user-secrets only, never written into settings JSON; replies show a mask only
models.searchProviderDesc: Empty = DuckDuckGo (no key needed); pick Bocha / SearXNG / SerpAPI-compatible as needed
models.searchBaseUrlDesc: Empty = provider default; set this for a self-hosted SearXNG or similar
models.imageModelDesc: Empty = provider's default image model; uses the OpenAI-compatible images API
models.embeddingProviderDesc: Empty = local small model (bge-small-zh-v1.5, ~95MB downloaded on first use); remote = an OpenAI-compatible /embeddings endpoint
models.embeddingBaseUrlDesc: Required for remote mode, e.g. https://api.example.com/v1
models.embeddingModelDesc: Empty = bge-small-zh-v1.5 in local mode; for remote, use the provider's model name
models.embeddingApiKeyDesc: Stored in user-secrets only, never written into settings JSON; replies show a mask only

chat.toolsEnabledDesc: One tool name per line. For "my condition isn't met but I want it anyway" — e.g. attachment_search with no attachments. Rarely needed: toggleable tools are already on.
chat.toolsDisabledDesc: One tool name per line; listed tools are not mounted for the turn (disabling wins over enabling). exec sits here by default — it runs commands on this machine, so delete the line only if you want it.
chat.sandboxNetworkDesc: Lets code_execution and exec reach the network (off by default). Code still has to request network itself per call; credentials and proxy variables never enter the sandbox.

kb.chunkSizeDesc: PDF is split by page, then merged up to this length within a page; too large blurs retrieval, too small cuts sentences
kb.chunkOverlapDesc: Overlap between neighbouring chunks so a sentence cut in half is still findable on both sides
kb.embeddingBatchSizeDesc: How many chunks go to the embedder at once; smaller is safer for remote endpoints, larger is faster locally
kb.parseEngineDesc: Empty = pick by file type (PDF goes through PyMuPDF and keeps page numbers); P4 only ships the automatic path — other values fall back to it with a warning

settings.appearanceDesc: Theme and language — takes effect instantly after Apply.
settings.modelsDesc: LLM connection — a connectivity probe runs on Apply; failure keeps the current config.
settings.chatDesc: Tool toggles — Apply takes effect immediately; the next turn mounts tools per these switches.
settings.kbDesc: Chunking and embedding parameters for local knowledge bases; rebuild the index in Knowledge Center after changing them
settings.toolsDesc: Every built-in tool (click for its parameter schema). Always = mounted every turn; Context = mounted when its condition holds; Toggleable = on by default, turns off when listed under Disable. Not ready = a prerequisite is missing (e.g. no image model set), so it cannot run yet.
settings.toolsLoadFailed: Could not load the tool list — is the backend running?
settings.draftSaved: Draft saved — click Apply to take effect

knowledge.title: Knowledge
knowledge.desc: Drop in slides, papers and books — chat can cite them down to the page.
knowledge.empty: No knowledge base yet. Create one and add some files.
knowledge.nameRequired: Give the knowledge base a name first.
knowledge.filesHint: PDF / text / Office documents, up to 50MB each
knowledge.deleteKbConfirm: Delete “{name}”? Documents and index go with it, no way back.
knowledge.deleteDocConfirm: Delete “{name}”? Its content drops out of the index right away.
knowledge.noDocs: This base is empty — add some files first.
knowledge.rebuildingHint: Rebuilding v{n}, the old index still answers queries
knowledge.searchPlaceholder: Ask a question or type keywords…
knowledge.readerPdfHint: Page anchors depend on the browser's PDF viewer: Chrome / Edge jump to the page, Firefox needs manual scrolling.
knowledge.openOriginal: Open the original in a new tab
knowledge.readerLoadError: Couldn't load the preview — download the original instead.
knowledge.readerTooLarge: File is too large to preview here — download it instead.
knowledge.readerOfficeTextHint: Showing the extracted text — the same content the model reads. Download the original for full formatting.
knowledge.readerDocxError: Couldn't render this Word document — download it and open it in Office.
knowledge.readerXlsxError: Couldn't render this spreadsheet — download it and open it in Excel.
knowledge.readerXlsxTruncated: Large sheet — preview truncated. Download for the full file.
knowledge.readerNoSheets: This workbook has no sheets to preview.
knowledge.readerFallback: Preview is not available for this file type.
knowledge.notFound: This knowledge base does not exist, or it was deleted.

notebooks.title: Notebooks
notebooks.desc: Keep solutions, answers and quick notes here so you can find them later.
notebooks.emptyHint: Create one, or hit "Save to notebook" on any answer in the chat.
notebooks.deleteConfirm: Delete "{name}"? Its records go with it.
notebooks.notFound: This notebook does not exist or was deleted.
notebooks.noteTitlePlaceholder: Title (leave empty to use the first line)
notebooks.notePlaceholder: Write something… Markdown and LaTeX supported

questions.title: Question Bank
questions.desc: Questions from quiz turns, from chat, and ones you wrote yourself — answer them and review mistakes here.
questions.emptyHint: Pick the "Quiz" capability in chat to generate a batch, or click "New question" to write one.
questions.optionsRequired: A choice question needs at least two options
questions.optionsPlaceholder: One option per line (labels A/B/C/D are assigned in order)
questions.answerPlaceholder: Correct answer: B for single choice, ABD for multi choice
questions.keyPlaceholder: Reference answer (grading treats it as authoritative)
questions.deleteConfirm: Delete this question? Its attempt history goes with it.
